title: City Council — June 2, 2026 Work Session and Business Meeting

votes.motion: MOTION: Council Member Birrell moved to ADJOURN the City Council Work Session and open a Closed Meeting for the purpose of discussing real property; the character and professional competence or physical or mental health of an individual; or any other permitted purposes. The motion was seconded by Council Member Holton
MOTION: Council Member Birrell moved to CLOSE the Public Hearing on the Tentative Budget. The motion was seconded by Council Member Hyland

MOTION: Council Member Newell moved to APPROVE Resolution 2026-35 – Emphasizing Severe Drought Conditions and Providing Enhanced Water Conservation measures for City Residents and Businesses. The motion was seconded by Council Member Birrell. Vote on Motion: Council Member Holton-Yes; Council Member Hyland-Yes; Council Member Newell- Yes; Council Member Birrell-Yes; Mayor Bennion-Yes
MOTION: Council Member Holton moved to APPROVE the Minutes of the May 5, 2026 City Council Work Session and Business Meetings. The motion was seconded by Council Member Newell
MOTION: Council Member Hyland moved to ADJOURN. The motion was seconded by Council Member Holton
